prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1403; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Can you confirm you're comfortable with us recording this call?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please describe where the collision happened and what you were doing at the time.

A: It was in a parking lot at a shopping center in Sugar Land, Texas. I had just pulled into a spot near the store entrance and was backing out to leave.

Q: What happened as you were backing out?

A: I checked my mirrors and didn't see anything behind me, so I started slowly reversing. Then I felt a bump on the driver's side rear and heard a crunch. The other vehicle had come down the aisle and I didn't see it in time.

Q: How fast were you moving when the contact occurred?

A: Very slowly, maybe a walking pace. I was barely rolling.

Q: Was anyone else in your vehicle?

A: No, I was alone.

Q: Did you get out and speak with the other driver?

A: Yes. We exchanged insurance information and took a few photos of both cars with our phones.

Q: Did you feel any injury at the scene?

A: Not right away. My lower back felt tight, and by the next morning it was sore and stiff. I've been diagnosed with a back strain and I'm doing physical therapy.

Q: Have you seen a medical provider since the collision?

A: Yes, I saw a doctor and I'm following the treatment plan they gave me.

Q: Is there anything you would like to add or correct about your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
